contentBlocks.value: Exciting news from the North Central Coast of Vietnam!

Let’s Do It Vietnam and Legacy International will serve as technical advisors for the LAM Project — a regional initiative connecting the provinces of Thanh Hoa, Nghe An, and Ha Tinh. The project aims to protect marine environments, restore coastal ecosystems, and promote sustainable development across the region.

LAM Project is part of the On-demand Youth Leadership Program ODYLP, which includes immersive learning, mentorship, and cultural exchange experiences in Kansas and Washington D.C. Young changemakers are launching community-based projects as a commitment to driving positive impact — a meaningful tribute to the 30th anniversary of U.S.–Vietnam diplomatic relations.
